entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. Order number is 994-5821.
Certainly, I can help with that. Let me just pull up that order... 994-5821. Okay, I see it here for the VeloBand Pulse. And when did you receive this item?
I don't know, a while ago. A couple of months, maybe? I just finally got around to trying it and it's not for me.

Okay, I see here it was delivered about 85 days ago. Don't worry, our standard policy gives you a full 90 days for returns, so you have plenty of time. I can go ahead and get that return label sent to your email.
Oh, great. I was worried I'd missed the cut-off. Yeah, please send the label.
My pleasure. Just one moment while I process this in the system... hmm. That's odd. Just a second.
Is there a problem? You just said I had time.

Sir, I am so sorry. I've just realized my mistake. It seems our standard policy applies to apparel and accessories, but electronics like the VeloBand Pulse actually have a 60-day return window. I'm afraid the system won't let me proceed because it's been 85 days.

Are you kidding me? You literally just told me I had 'plenty of time'. I've been on hold and now you're telling me you gave me the wrong information and I'm stuck with this thing? This is unbelievable.
You're absolutely right to be upset, and I take full responsibility for the misinformation. I sincerely apologize. I can see the policy note now and should have checked it before confirming.
So what are you going to do about it? I'm not paying for your mistake.

I completely understand. While I cannot override the system to accept the return, I want to make this right because the error was mine. I can immediately apply a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for the trouble I've caused.
$25? This tracker cost me $150! That's not a solution.

I know it's not the same, and I wish I could do more. As a newer agent, a $25 credit is the maximum I'm authorized to offer. I know it's frustrating, but I hope it shows that we value your business and are sorry for the mix-up.
Ugh... fine. It's better than nothing, I guess. I can't believe this.
Thank you for your understanding. I've just applied that $25 credit to your account. You should see it effective immediately on your next purchase. Again, I am truly sorry for my mistake today.
Okay... look, I know you're just doing your job. Thank you for doing what you could to fix it. I appreciate that.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
